meta.note: Coaching cues written for this protocol. Before relying on them, check each exercise against one demo video you trust and paste that video's link into video_url. Rehab exercises are not included and must come from the rehab program.
meta.defaults_note: Rest and switch-sides timings live in protocol.json under session_defaults, which is the single source of truth. Resolved 2026-09-21: 60 s rest, 10 s switch sides.
meta.ladder_note: Each ladder follows the protocol: reps to the top of the range first, then leverage (feet elevated, 3-second lowering, pause at the hardest point), then backpack load (1 litre of water = 1 kg, up to about 12 kg).

blocks.what: Easy marching in place or light jumping jacks
Mobility: hip circles, leg swings, arm circles, cat-cow
One easy ramp-up set of the day's first exercise at about half effort

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.setup: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders. Body in one straight line from head to heels, glutes and abs tight.
cues: Lower with elbows angled about 45 degrees from your body, not flared straight out.
Stop with your chest a fist's height from the floor, then push the floor away.
Keep the straight line the whole time.
common_mistakes: Half reps that stop well short of the floor
exercises.easier: Hands on a bench, chair, or wall.
ladder: Pause 1 to 2 seconds just above the floor
Backpack load, 1 to 2 kg at a time, up to about 12 kg

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
equipment: Chair, bench, or step behind you
exercises.setup: Rear foot laces-down on a chair or bench behind you. Front foot far enough forward that your front heel stays down at the bottom.
cues: Drop the back knee straight down toward the floor.
Keep the front knee tracking over your toes, not caving inward.
Drive up through the whole front foot, heel included.
common_mistakes: Front foot too close, so the heel lifts
exercises.easier: Split squat with the back foot on the floor, holding a doorframe for balance.
ladder: Pause 1 to 2 seconds at the bottom
Backpack load, 1 to 2 kg at a time

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.setup: Hands shoulder-width on the floor, hips high in an upside-down V, head between your arms.
cues: Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward a spot just in front of your hands.
Keep your hips high; this is a vertical press, not a regular push-up.
Press back up to the V.
common_mistakes: Hips dropping so it turns into a push-up
exercises.easier: Walk your feet farther back so your torso is less vertical.
exercises.ladder_end_note: Backpack load is impractical here. When this ladder tops out, the app should suggest a harder vertical-push variation instead.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.setup: Stand on one leg with a soft bend in the knee.
cues: Push your hips back as the free leg extends behind you; torso and back leg move as one straight line.
Keep your hips square to the floor, not rotating open.
Stand up by driving the standing hip forward and squeezing the glute.
common_mistakes: Hip rotating open toward the ceiling
Bending the standing knee into a squat
exercises.easier: Kickstand version (back toes lightly touching the floor), or one hand on a wall.
ladder: Backpack held in the hand opposite the standing leg, 1 to 2 kg at a time

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.setup: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor.
cues: Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor, arms reaching past your ears or toward your feet.
Keep your legs straight and only as low as you can while your lower back stays down.
Breathe shallowly with your ribs pulled down.
common_mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor
exercises.easier: Tuck hollow: knees bent, arms by your sides.
ladder: Legs lower while the back stays down

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.setup: Overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders. Start from a dead hang with your shoulders set, pulled slightly down away from your ears.
cues: Drive your elbows down toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control all the way to straight arms.
No swinging or kicking.
common_mistakes: Half reps that skip the bottom
Shrugging shoulders up to the ears
exercises.easier: Negatives (step to the top, lower over 3 to 5 seconds) or feet-assisted from a chair.
ladder: Backpack load, 1 to 2 kg at a time

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.setup_choice: Low bar, confirmed 2026-09-21. The exact bar is still to be named; bar height is the first rung of the difficulty ladder, so lower the bar to make it harder.
exercises.setup: Lie under a low bar and grip it shoulder-width apart. Body straight from head to heels, heels on the floor. The lower the bar, the harder the row.
cues: Pull your chest to the edge, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Keep your hips up and your body rigid.
Lower under control to straight arms.
common_mistakes: Using an anchor that can tip, slide, or rotate
exercises.safety: Hang your full weight from the bar standing up before you get under it for the first set. Check that nothing rotates or slides.
exercises.easier: Bend your knees, or raise the bar so your body is more upright.
ladder: Bar lowered so the body is more horizontal
Backpack load, 1 to 2 kg at a time

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.setup: Underhand grip, hands shoulder-width. Start from a dead hang.
cues: Pull your chest toward the bar, elbows driving down and in.
Get your chin over the bar, then lower fully.
Keep the body still; no swinging.
common_mistakes: Stopping short of a full hang
Craning the neck to get the chin over
exercises.easier: Negatives, or feet-assisted from a chair.
ladder: Backpack load, 1 to 2 kg at a time

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.setup: Upper back against the edge of a couch or bench, one foot planted, the other leg lifted.
cues: Drive through your heel and lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Pause and squeeze the glute at the top.
Keep your ribs down; the lift comes from the hip, not an arched lower back.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top
exercises.easier: Single-leg glute bridge on the floor, or both feet down.
ladder: Backpack on the hips, 1 to 2 kg at a time

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.setup: Dead hang from the bar, shoulders set, legs together.
cues: Lift your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis up, not just lifting your thighs.
Lower slowly without swinging.
If you start swinging, pause in a still hang before the next rep.
exercises.easier: Lying reverse crunch on the floor.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.setup: On your side, elbow under your shoulder, feet stacked or staggered.
cues: Lift your hips so your body forms one straight line from head to feet.
Keep your hips stacked; do not roll forward.
Push the floor away with your forearm.

exercises.name: Push-up, feet up
exercises.pattern: Horizontal push, incline toward the shoulders
equipment: Chair or bench for your feet
exercises.setup: Feet on a chair or bench, hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line.
cues: Lower until your face is a fist's height from the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the floor away, keeping the line.
Do not let your hips pike up.
ladder: Backpack load, 1 to 2 kg at a time

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.setup: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
cues: Step one foot back and lower the back knee toward the floor.
Keep the front shin close to vertical and the front knee over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
common_mistakes: Step too short, so the front heel lifts
Pushing off the back foot instead of the front leg
exercises.easier: Split squat in place, holding a wall.
ladder: Backpack load, 1 to 2 kg at a time

exercises.name: Hamstring bridge curl
equipment: Towel on a smooth floor, or socks on a hard floor
exercises.interpretation_confirmed: Sliding hamstring curl from a bridge. Confirmed 2026-09-21.
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
cues: Lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping your hips high, slide your heels out until your legs are nearly straight, then pull them back in.
Move slowly; if your hamstrings cramp, shorten the range.
exercises.easier: Slide out slowly only (the lowering half), then reset with feet flat.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.setup: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step with your heel hanging off, or on a flat floor. Touch a wall lightly for balance only.
cues: Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for one second at the top.
Lower slowly, below step level if you are on a step.
common_mistakes: Rolling onto the outside of the foot
ladder: Single leg on a flat floor
Single leg on a step edge
Backpack load, 1 to 2 kg at a time

cardio.name: Wall tennis
cardio.how: Rally against a wall at a pace that keeps heart rate in Zone 2 and passes the talk test.

cardio.name: Hill walk
cardio.how: Brisk uphill walking at Zone 2 effort.

cardio.name: Hill repeats
cardio.how: Hard uphill efforts with easy walk-down recoveries, aiming for the interval zone during efforts. Structure is an open decision.

cardio.name: Tennis singles
cardio.how: A singles match; heart rate will rise and fall with the points.
